evidence: T038 receipt records passing security:check, lint, typecheck, 21 tests, 4 e2e tests, 4 a11y tests, build, and preserved production-safe CSP; reports also record passing visual and Docker /health evidence.

Current public routes exist but many render placeholders, omit required metadata, or provide only minimal planned-state prose; the homepage shows three projects and project cards lack required image, version, update, and source presentation.
packages/content contains shallow inline registries and reduced schemas; people and roadmap are hardcoded in route components, and no complete validated content repository structure exists.

packages/design-system/src/index.ts is only a status marker; tokens diverge from the brand guide, globals use Georgia/system fonts and hardcoded colors, and no dark-theme implementation or component library is wired into the app.

Documentation uses packages/docs-ingestion and custom rendering; apps/web has no Fumadocs dependency, configured Git source, verified commit-SHA import, complete taxonomy/reference components, or demonstrated standards-monorepo production source.
apps/web/src/lib/newsletter.ts submitNewsletter always returns disabled; the form lacks the required privacy link and no Kit provider success, timeout, duplicate, or failure contract is implemented.

config/search.yml is static mode; the focused search implementation and CSP/browser gate pass, but hosted Typesense activation, production search-key verification, full content-type coverage after future content changes, analytics, and rollback evidence remain absent.

IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md and LAUNCH_READINESS.md explicitly leave Lighthouse, external providers, Tower/Coolify, Infisical, DNS/TLS, production deployment/monitoring, and qualified legal/factual review pending.
